mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% triggers aggressive monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS has been below 0.25% for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in FEDFUNDS and rises in CPIAUCSL signal accommodative policy amid inflation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through yield curve compression.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) triggers Fed policy accommodation, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising residential construction activity (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer spending, consistently driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as economic momentum builds.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) for two consecutive months signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0 for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer credit contraction (RSAFS < 400000 million dollars) reduces household spending capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as revenue growth slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is below 400000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signal labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through recession fears.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
